reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) describes Ti/Ni coatings on diamond particles in a HEA matrix, not Ag coatings on W in a Cu matrix. It does not address thermal conductivity, electron–phonon coupling, or irradiation resistance, and thus provides no specific support for any of the key premises.
premises: A ~20 nm Ag coating on W particles can be deposited uniformly via electroless plating
A nanostructured Ag interlayer forms at W/Cu interfaces after sintering at ~1000 °C
Ag interlayer reduces thermal boundary resistance by enhancing electron–phonon energy transfer
Ag interlayer maintains mechanical durability under thermal cycling and irradiation
Ag interlayer does not degrade irradiation resistance of the composite
